caption: One Hide shipping methods rule saved as Active about 1.5 minutes after the install, on the free Development plan. The store name and the example test email are hidden.
The rule list shows it Active since 17 November 2026; we never saw it in a real checkout. The store name is hidden.
Paid plans: Starter $4.99 (2 rules), Advanced $12.99 and Premium $29.99 a month, each with a 5 day trial. The store name is hidden.
Clicking Select plan for Starter did nothing and no approval screen opened; the Free plan only runs rules in Testing status. The store name and a reviewer's name are hidden.
The uninstall dialog sends the developer a request to delete customer data within 48 hours and wants a reason before Uninstall turns active.
